subject: Commercial clarifications and proposed pricing pathway for Archwell Health RFP
messages:
From: Maria Gonzales <mgonzales@archwellhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Commercial Clarifications - Archwell Health

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with your latency profile and the built-in routing options. As we prepare our commercial appendix for the Archwell RFP, we need clarified positions on the following areas before we move to procurement review:

1) Token pricing unit and cadence: confirm the unit (1k tokens) and whether pricing tiers are applied monthly or annually for true-ups.
2) Commit & overage construct: sample monthly commit tiers, associated discounts off list price, and how overages are invoiced (per 1k tokens; any cap or surge cushion).
3) True-up & credits: explanation of the quarterly/annual true-up process and crediting mechanics (carry-forward vs invoice credits).
4) Usage buffer / "lockbox" concept: Archwell prefers a pre-funded buffer for predictable billing during launch spikes — can you outline a lockbox option (size, drawdown rules, replenishment, and when credits are applied)?
5) Early termination / penalty waivers: do you provide waiver paths if usage ramps faster than anticipated or the customer achieves >80% of committed volume prior to termination?
6) Dedicated capacity pricing: brief numbers for a 2x4 GPU pool with reserved throughput SLA (if different from hosted unit economics).

We'd like a written commercial addendum and a sample PO within five business days so procurement can circulate internally. I attached our commercial questions as a PDF.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzales
Head of Procurement
Archwell Health

Attachment: Archwell_RFP_Commercial_Questions.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzales <mgonzales@archwellhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Commercial Clarifications - Archwell Health

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a focused commercial proposal that addresses each item (RWD_Commercial_Proposal_Archwell_v1.xlsx) and a short explainer for the usage lockbox (Usage_Lockbox_Terms.pdf). Key points below; the attached spreadsheet expands examples to different annual commit sizes.

Summary (high level)
- Unit: pricing shown per 1,000 tokens ("per-1k"). All invoices and true-ups operate on per-1k token increments.
- List (hosted) baseline: $14.00 per-1k (generative + safety profile we showed) — this is our published list for on-demand usage.
- Commit discounts: tiered volume discounts off list, applied to committed volume and overage pricing as detailed:
  - Monthly commit equivalent 0.5M–2M per month (6M–24M annual): 10% discount
  - 2M–8M per month (24M–96M annual): 18% discount
  - >8M per month: 26% discount
- Overage pricing: overages billed at list less a floor discount (see examples):
  - Standard overage = list * (1 - floor_discount). Floor_discount = 5% for lower tiers, 8% for mid, 12% for top tier.
  - We apply invoice-level smoothing (see below) so single-month spikes are mitigated.
- True-up mechanics: quarterly true-up by default (aligned to Archwell fiscal quarters). During true-up we calculate committed volume vs actual; shortfalls invoice the committed discount gap; over-usage results in overage charges. Credits from pre-funded lockbox are applied at true-up or earlier if requested and within replenishment rules. Credits are carried forward for up to 12 months if unused.
- Usage lockbox (optional add-on):
  - Concept: Archwell prepays an agreed token credit pool to cover burst traffic during product launches; the pool is held as a customer credit balance.
  - Typical size: 10%–30% of annual committed tokens (customer choice).
  - Drawdown & replenishment: automatic drawdown for overages above committed monthly amounts; when balance falls below threshold (20%), Redwood notifies and initiates optional auto-replenishment (PO-based).
  - Accounting: lockbox amounts show on invoices as prepayments/credits. At true-up, remaining credits are either carried forward (12-month max) or refunded per PO terms.
- Penalty waivers / early termination:
  - If Archwell reaches >=80% of annual committed volume before contract term midpoint, Redwood will waive early termination penalties and pro-rate remaining committed discounts into final invoice credits. This is subject to a standard settlement schedule and is intended to avoid "penalty for success."
- Dedicated (Reserved) pool pricing (2x4 GPU example): monthly rate = $65,000/month (includes reserved throughput SLA and 7-day rolling failover). This is separate from per-token accounting; we provide a blended per-1k estimate in the attached workbook if you want a blended economics view.

Attached documents: RWD_Commercial_Proposal_Archwell_v1.xlsx (pricing table + worked examples), Usage_Lockbox_Terms.pdf (lockbox mechanics and sample ledger entries).

Next steps: if this matches expectations we'll prepare a short commercial addendum and a sample PO language. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call with procurement and finance to walk through the examples.

Regards,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: RWD_Commercial_Proposal_Archwell_v1.xlsx, Usage_Lockbox_Terms.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Archwell commercial concession discussion (notes)

Soojin — quick internal note following your proposal. Points for alignment before we send final addendum: 

1) Discount caps & escalation: the proposal has a 26% max discount at large volumes. Marketing wins and long-term retention often want an additional negotiated marketing-credit at signature (one-time) rather than increasing the ongoing discount. Recommend: keep 26% public, offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 2% of first-year committed spend.

2) Lockbox flexibility: Archwell asked for auto-replenish. Risk: small customers could leave a large prepaid balance unused. Proposal: auto-replenish only if customer enables it in PO; otherwise send two escalation notices before any replenishment charge.

3) True-up window: propose 90-day grace window for first year only (helps for ramping pilots). After year one revert to standard quarterly true-ups.

4) Penalty waiver trigger: the >=80% ramp waiver is fine but require a minimum 6-month notice to legal ops to validate usage data. Also add requirement that waived penalties convert to invoice credits with a 6-month settlement schedule rather than immediate cash refund.

5) Dedicated pool margin: our 2x4 GPU estimate is OK but pull latest infra cost from finance before locking $65k/month. We should offer a blended per-1k illustrative rate (as you included) but flag that it is indicative and will be firmed on SOW.

If you want I can draft a short two-paragraph concession memo we attach to the commercial addendum that lists these optional concessions and the approvals required (rev ops + finance sign-off for lockbox auto-replenish).

-Karthik

[Internal — no external recipients]

A few requests before we proceed to signature: 

- Please prepare the commercial addendum (two pages) that includes: agreed commit tiers, discounts, true-up cadence, lockbox mechanics, and the penalty waiver conditions.
- Send a short PO template (we will use this to trigger auto-replenishment option if we select it).
- We will require DocuSign for the addendum + SOW; please include the onboarding credit (2% of first-year committed spend) as a line item so procurement can route approvals.

If you can provide the addendum and DocuSign package early next week we will circulate it internally and come back with a PO. Happy to schedule a 30-minute call if you prefer to walk procurement/legal through the terms.

Best,
